routing_warnings.description: The client's approval concerns the presented design direction, while the launch-video and hero-product example clauses concern narrower presentation Requirements.
The implementation claim concerns the separately developed contact page; connecting the early-access button belongs to REQ_EARLY_ACCESS_CTA_ROUTING.
The URL and completion statement concern publishing the site at the custom domain rather than building the core Webflow artifact.
The supplied get.lotclip.com URL concerns the revised subdomain routing.
The requested buttons and multiple images concern the independently defined hero product visual.
The requested hero-image replacement concerns the independently defined hero product visual; only the overall-design approval belongs to the target Requirement.
The requested founder-image replacement concerns the independently defined bottom-section image.
The dealer-login placement change belongs to its own Requirement; only the overall-layout approval belongs to the target Requirement.
The observed failure concerns the existing product being displaced at the apex domain, which has its own Requirement.
The client requests restoration of the pre-existing apex-domain record rather than changing the landing-page subdomain.
The client asks whether the previous apex-domain destination will be restored.
The message reports restoration and normal service at the apex lotclip.com product route.
The same message separately reports that www.lotclip.com remains broken because it was removed from Firebase Hosting configuration.
The client delegates the remaining www-domain repair to another person.
The source separately reports that www.lotclip.com still shows a Site Not Found page; that clause belongs to the independent www-domain routing Requirement.
The redirect from the early-access CTA to the contact page belongs to the CTA-routing Requirement.
This message establishes the Founding Dealer contact-page copy rather than page availability.
The reported typo is a runtime failure of contact-page copy, although viewing it also confirms that the page is available.
The successful test lead verifies contact-form submission and delivery rather than merely page availability.
The completed-development claim concerns the contact page; the CTA connection is described only as remaining work.
The reported typo concerns contact-page content rather than early-access CTA routing.
This message asks about the behavior of the Request Early Access button rather than changing the form itself.
This message defines the early-access button redirect to the contact page.
This message removes direct email and phone contact options from the contact page and makes the form the sole contact method.
The reported contact-page typo concerns page copy rather than the contact form's submission behavior.
The published www.lotclip.com URL appears to report completion of custom-domain routing rather than selection or purchase of the Webflow plan.
The URL relates to hosting the landing page at get.lotclip.com and does not support the no-animations Requirement.

missing_requirement_candidates.description: The freelancer requests the dealer-login destination and the client supplies https://admin.lotclip.com/login; this independently specifies button routing rather than placement.
